title: Render meal-plan item rows and persist swipe deletions
description: Add row rendering for recipe, text, and ingredient items, hook recipe taps into `RecipeDetailSheet`, and persist swipe deletions through typed plan mutation and reserialisation.
acceptance_criteria: Recipe rows resolve recipe URLs, show thumbnails or placeholders, display optional servings text, and open the existing recipe detail sheet.
Text rows render plain text with semibold styling only for trailing-colon labels and remain non-interactive.
Ingredient rows render the cart icon and quantity text formatting required by the spec.
Swipe-to-delete on supported row types mutates the in-memory `MealPlan`, serialises it once, and writes back via `MealPlanFiles.writeText` without string surgery in the view layer.

handoff_summary.completed:
- Created CookbookApp/MealPlans/MealPlanItemRow.swift with MealPlanRecipeRow (thumbnail via RecipeThumbnailView, sentence-cased display name, optional servings label, chevron, tap handler, swipe-delete), MealPlanTextRow (semibold for colon-suffix, swipe-delete), MealPlanIngredientRow (cart icon, name+quantity text, swipe-delete).
- Removed 6 redundant private structs from MealPlanDetailView.swift (RecipeListItem, TextListItem, IngredientListItem, MealPlanRecipeRow, MealPlanTextRow, MealPlanIngredientRow).
- Updated planItemRow in MealPlanDetailView to call the extracted row structs directly.
- Ran xcodegen generate to register MealPlanItemRow.swift in the Xcode project.
- Build succeeded (xcodebuild BUILD SUCCEEDED).
handoff_summary.remaining: Tester agent should verify: recipe rows show thumbnails/placeholders with sentence-cased names; text rows apply semibold for colon-suffix strings; ingredient rows render cart icon and quantity text; swipe-delete correctly mutates MealPlan, serialises, and writes via MealPlanFiles.writeText.
handoff_summary.risks: None significant. SourceKit emits a false-positive 'No such module CookbookCore' diagnostic on the new file because the index hasn't refreshed after xcodegen; the build itself passes cleanly.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify row rendering and swipe-delete persistence against the acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — MealPlanItemRow.swift is a new file; MealPlanDetailView.swift changes are additive (removal of private dead code after extraction). No overlap with sibling beads expected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Row views are self-contained (tap + swipe actions included) rather than split into content-only and interaction-wrapper structs, following the ShoppingListItemRow pattern. sentence-casing applied to recipe display names per spec. Thumbnail size remains 44×44 (clipped from RecipeThumbnailView's internal 56×56) to match the pre-existing detail-view style.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added — test coverage is the tester agent's responsibility. The three row view structs are internal (not private) so they are unit-testable by CookbookAppTests.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: RecipeThumbnailView.loadImage uses Data(contentsOf:) without an explicit security-scoped resource bracket. This works because RecipesFolderStore holds continuous access on the folder; it would fail if the store's access ever lapses mid-load.

conflict_risks: None — MealPlanItemRow.swift is a new file; MealPlanDetailView.swift changes are additive (removal of private dead code after extraction). No overlap with sibling beads expected.

execution_history.summary: Created MealPlanItemRow.swift with three internal row views (MealPlanRecipeRow, MealPlanTextRow, MealPlanIngredientRow), each self-contained with swipe-to-delete. Removed the 6 inlined private structs from MealPlanDetailView.swift (3 content-only Row views + 3 ListItem swipe-action wrappers) and updated planItemRow to use the extracted views directly. Ran xcodegen generate; build succeeded.
